ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity dark pigments to high-intensity white mottling across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity white mottling clusters occupy the distal 35% of the left lobe. The right lobe features a localized high-intensity patch at the distal tip and along the superior trailing edge. The central region surrounding the median notch is characterized by a contiguous low-intensity dark zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a significant depth relative to the fluke's chord line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels are detected along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks are concentrated at the distal extremities of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge boundaries follow a primarily convex mathematical curve sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) are localized within the dark pigmented zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected; specifically, a set of diagonal light-colored lines is visible on the dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe and irregular, jagged pixel boundaries at the extreme distal tips indicative of minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific asymmetrical density of the white speckled mottling on the left lobe relative to the more solid pigmentation of the right lobe.
